# Source reconciliation: issue #380

**Date:** 2026-10-17

**Source baseline:** [`4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/commit/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0)

**Scope:** read-only reconciliation of [issue #380](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/issues/380) and [the 2026-10-08 code-integrity audit](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/.github/audits/2026-10-08/CODE-INTEGRITY-AUDIT.md). Findings below describe source at this SHA; they do not establish live behavior, cost, or production incidents. No tests or runtime changes were made.

## Current-code findings

| Finding | Status at baseline | Source and contract action |
|---|---|---|
| C01 payload immutability | **Open** | [`research-session-application.ts:201-210`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/cloudflare-research-runtime/src/research-session-application.ts#L201-L210): HEAD failure is treated as absence; PUT is unconditional; failed PUT has no reconciliation. Use conditional create, then bounded exact readback on race/lost ACK; distinguish same bytes, conflict, and unavailable observation. Keep this pre-ledger payload path and its metadata contract. |
| C02 expected digest fallback | **Open, bounded risk** | [`research-session-application.ts:260-270`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/cloudflare-research-runtime/src/research-session-application.ts#L260-L270): missing R2 checksum returns expected `payloadHash`; HEAD failure becomes null. Audit notes normal caller already checked exact payload, so no evidence bypass was demonstrated. Use stored checksum or bounded byte hash; preserve unavailable/integrity error rather than synthesizing an observation. |
| C03 payload/receipt bounds | **Open** | [`types.ts:9-16`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/cloudflare-workflows/src/types.ts#L9-L16), [`research-session-application.ts:183-199`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/cloudflare-research-runtime/src/research-session-application.ts#L183-L199), [`research-protocol-freeze.ts:139-148`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/cloudflare-research-branches/src/research-protocol-freeze.ts#L139-L148): 64 KiB receipt bound also caps stored query + planning payload; HTTP request allows 262144 bytes ([`research.ts:8-10`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/contracts/src/research.ts#L8-L10)). Version and align HTTP, immutable planning/R2 input, and receipt bounds across writer/readers; preserve legacy codec identities. Do not just raise one constant. |
| C04 duplicate AI stream readers | **Fixed for the cited AI response readers** | [`provider-config-rest-response.ts:77-86`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/cloudflare-ai/src/provider-config-rest-response.ts#L77-L86) and [`custom-provider-rest-response.ts:75-84`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/cloudflare-ai/src/custom-provider-rest-response.ts#L75-L84) both use shared `readResponseBodyWithinBytes`. [`runtime-limits.ts:125-177,209-239`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/platform-cloudflare/src/runtime-limits.ts#L125-L177) supplies byte/chunk bounds, owned chunk copies, lock release and non-blocking cancellation. Keep one shared primitive; no local copies. Other callsites named in the old audit are outside this two-reader resolution. |
| C05 freshness response mismatch | **Open** | [`source-revision-freshness.ts:97-157`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/cloudflare-navigation/src/source-revision-freshness.ts#L97-L157) returns all changed sources; owner research scopes permit 4096 ([`owner-scope-profile.ts:8-16`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/cloudflare-navigation/src/owner-scope-profile.ts#L8-L16)); report client rejects over 64 ([`research-run-api.ts:241-262`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/pwa-research-workspace/src/research-run-api.ts#L241-L262)). Align versioned member/byte bounds; any sample/cursor must declare truncation and preserve the total count. Never silently represent a partial set as complete. |

Encode once after normalization; run local bound/claim checks before paid verification and reuse bytes. Keep semantic verification and authority checks. Avoid claiming measured savings. |

This addresses the 10/08 missing/null/non-array/unbounded-container issue. |

Treat it as transport/readback settlement pending historical binding inventory, not grounds for blind deletion. |
| C10 quadratic freshness membership | **Open, bounded efficiency issue** | [`source-revision-freshness.ts:121-136`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/cloudflare-navigation/src/source-revision-freshness.ts#L121-L136): page reconciliation uses a Set, then each row checks `refs.includes`. Replace with one Set or retain the page-set proof plus duplicate check. This is static O(N²), not a measured production slowdown; no cache or fan-out is indicated. |
| C11 R2 unavailable read mapped to conflict | **Open** | [`r2.ts:218-225,381-418`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/platform-cloudflare/src/r2.ts#L218-L225): retryable `R2_DIGEST_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE` can arise during verification; `reconcileConditionalWrite` maps any non-missing `R2IntegrityError` to non-retryable immutable conflict. Allowlist observed size/digest/metadata mismatches as conflicts; preserve verifier/read unavailability and first cause as unavailable/unknown. Do not make all failures retryable. |

### Managed OAuth final check

The second `createManagedOAuthOwnerContext` at [`apps/eliotr-core/src/index.ts:123-130`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/apps/eliotr-core/src/index.ts#L123-L130) is a functional post-read final check: [`mcp-research-service.ts:74-97`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/apps/eliotr-core/src/mcp-research-service.ts#L74-L97) revalidates verified actor, credential/deployment/issuer bindings, request cancellation and `expires_at <= Date.now()`, throwing if the identity expired during the read. Catalog also fences authority across its read at [`catalog-service.ts:284-301,364`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/packages/cloudflare-navigation/src/catalog-service.ts#L284-L301). Preserve the current Managed OAuth contract while it remains selected. ADR-0018 explicitly changes the OWNER_SINGLE read boundary; an implementation of that profile may replace this path with its ingress gate. Make that profile transition explicit rather than deleting the check as dead code or silently changing other clients.

## Issue #380 reconciliation

| Claim or recommendation | Reconciliation and action |
|---|---|
| Owner-single reads and ordinary E0/E1 answers should be simpler and streamed. | **Accepted architecture:** [ADR-0018](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/4e53d5e2296e7f4ed3ed29cef2f049891c5d20c0/docs/adr/0018-owner-single-function-first-profile.md) selects Access as entry gate, summary reads, exact verification at citation opening, one streamed synthesis, and 4–5 durable steps. Its latency targets remain unverified. The cited latency observations are dated ADR measurements; they do not establish how much time or cost each subsystem caused. |
| Delete “stub” Rust crates until Wasm is needed. | **Do not infer either deletion or release prerequisite.** [#377](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/issues/377) says Rust ports and historical audit programs are not release prerequisites and should return only for concrete live-product need; the user separately prefers compact Rust. Follow the selected compact implementation scope, not all 17 planned ports by default and not bulk deletion. Preserve the language-authority contract for any promoted Rust kernel. |
| Older S52 task/donor plans for a custom index, target generations and promotion/rollback. | **Canceled by #377:** use Cloudflare AI Search or the provider’s built-in search. These historical plans are not a recommendation from #380 and must not become a new implementation queue. |
| Archive 44 drafts / treat closure as implementation. | **#377 records the 44-PR archive; closure is not implementation or acceptance.** Current execution authority is [`backend-entrypoints.md`](../../../docs/implementation/backend-entrypoints.md). |
| Delete old worktrees or infer architectural waste from their count. | #380’s worktree/uncommitted-file counts describe a local environment, not this source baseline. This reconciliation did not inspect that environment; counts do not authorize deletion. |
| “150 migrations produced >150 tables.” | **Unverified; omitted as fact.** No reproducible schema inventory was established in this source review. |

No new LOC quotas or repository metrics are introduced here. This source review does not implement the runtime fixes, execute tests or qualify production behavior.
